speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's disease)

The clinical picture of a pruritic rash with hypopigmented macules, loss of eyebrows and eyelashes, and symmetric sensory loss in the palms is highly specific for leprosy; your history of working with rice and livestock may also suggest cutaneous leishmaniasis or histoplasmosis, but the eyebrow/eyelash loss points strongly toward leprosy.

REQUEST TEST: Skin slit-skin smear for acid-fast bacilli; REQUEST TEST: Lepral skin biopsy with PCR.
REQUEST IMAGES: Clinical photo of rash, eyebrows, and palms.
